Round 421 passes. I ran every C row in the real browser and found no bugs.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 Claims and scope at start | Pass. Claims equal A's expectation, stderr is empty, none of the 13 ids is NOT-FOUND, K19 prints `L58 OK`, and only the 4 granted paths changed. |
| 2 Patch identity and unit tests | Pass. The 3 changed files match B's patch byte for byte. The 14 covering files give 286/286. |
| 3 Mutants | Pass. My run gives the same 7 lines as B's summary, and the stream file passes 49/49 under two busy loops. |
| 4 Preview behaviour in the browser | Pass. Real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720: all 16 cells equal HEAD. R11 shows `paused [false]` and `advanced true`, so the preview keeps playing through the Snap and zoom changes. |
| 5 Play/stop smoke | Pass at both viewports. Position advances to 00:01.471 in 1.5 s, stays frozen for 600 ms after Stop, and there are no page errors. |
| 6 Auth | Pass. A new context with no credentials opens the demo `/studio-lab` with `auth_user` null. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with 0 `audio[src]`, and an anonymous `/api/studio-token` returns 401. |
| 7 Doc 271 | Pass. Line 4 is byte-exact, the 7 template headings are in order, and the mutant block matches. All 8 closed ids and the row ids they cite are present. |
| 8 Scope at end | Pass. End claims equal start claims, the diff is only the 3 granted files, and `l57-check` prints OK. |

The first 1440×900 read of `/studio/middle-east` came back with an empty body, probably a slow render. A re-run shows "Sign in required" at both viewports, so I did not count it as a bug.

- **Not run:** the fake-bearer auth path is blocked because the backend is unavailable in the cloud. The full test suite, typecheck, build and `verify` are gate rows, so I did not run them.
- **Not measured:** I did not measure export WAV data, because no export code changed. The new "stop the preview when the collection changes" behaviour cannot be reached in `/studio-lab`, so only the jsdom tests PL1–PL3 cover it.
- **For B:** A's reviewer flagged a Low, A-R421-REVIEW-L1. No test checks that an already-playing decoded-buffer preview stops when the collection changes. It should go to `deferred_low_polish`.

I did not call the advisor before finishing.
